question: Speed of an aircraft is 120 Km /min. this speed in m/sec is:
solution:
Given:

The speed of an aircraft is 120 Km /min.

Concept used:

Time × Speed = Distance

1m/s = 18/5 km/h

Calculation:

The aircraft in 1 minute goes = 120 km

So, the aircraft in 60 minutes goes = 120 × 60 = 7200 km

Speed of the aircraft = 7200 km/h.

Now, the speed of the aircraft

⇒ 7200 × (5/18) = 2000 m/s

∴ The speed of the aircraft is 2000 m/s.
